frontMatter.yaml:
# Milestone 5: M4 + the evicted-ack cache.
# When acked (nil) entries are evicted from outstandingTasks because the
# read level regressed below them, the real code remembers them in a small
# bounded cache (evictedAcks, trimmed from the top). When such a task is
# re-read later, it is merged as a pre-acked entry instead of being
# re-delivered to the matcher. The cache is a pure optimization: every
# safety/liveness property of M4 must still hold. The dangerous property is
# that ONLY genuinely-acked tasks may enter the cache — a cached level that
# was never dispatched would be silently skipped (lost task).
# The cache size is 1 here (256 in the code) so trimming is exercised.
#
# Inherited from M4: unreliable DB (timeouts, retries, backoff races).
#
# Failure modes added (no "explicit failure"/conflict errors, per plan):
#  - GetFairTasks may time out: no side effects; the reader arms the backoff
#    timer (retryReadAfter) and exits the read loop; the timer restarts the
#    read (fix 26d9a561: the timer can fire before readTasksImpl finishes,
#    so readTasksImpl re-checks maybeReadTasksLocked at the end).
#  - CreateFairTasks may time out on the outgoing side (not applied) or the
#    incoming side (applied, response lost). Either way writeBatch skips
#    wroteNewTasks (tasks are NOT confirmed) and unpinAckLevel(err) sets
#    atEnd = false and triggers a read to re-establish the end (8ca7b640 #5).
#    History's retry writes a fresh task at a new level; an applied-but-
#    unconfirmed "zombie" row may be dispatched later (dup, allowed) or be
#    passed over by the ack level and GC'd (it carries no obligations).
#  - CompleteFairTasksLessThan may time out, applied or not; numToGC keeps
#    its count so GC retries later.
#
# Read outcomes use `fair any`, i.e. the network-fairness assumption that a
# forever-retried read eventually succeeds; without it liveness would
# trivially fail on the fail-forever path.
options:
  max_actions: 100
  max_concurrent_actions: 2
  crash_on_yield: false
deadlock_detection: false   # "all written tasks acked" is a valid final state
liveness: strict
